Recording System.definition: Device that records the response, as named in the article: the recording electrode (single sensillum recording), the amplifier or clamp (two-electrode voltage clamp), or the plate reader or microscope + camera (fluorescence). Never a technique, a mode such as 'manual', or a value that belongs to another column.

glass electrode.note: Glass capillary filled with sensillum lymph ringer, on an AgCl wire.

OC-725C.note: Warner Instruments oocyte clamp, model C.

OC-725D.note: Warner Instruments oocyte clamp, model D (RC3Z/OC-725D).

TEC-03BF.note: npi electronic two-electrode voltage clamp amplifier.

GeneClamp.note: Molecular Devices (Axon) GeneClamp amplifier; the article gives no model number.

FLUOstar Omega plate reader.note: BMG LABTECH FLUOstar Omega plate reader.

CLARIOstar Omega plate reader (BMG Labte.note: Spelling of the article (Roberts et al. 2022).

pending.Manual: Not in any article: replace by the amplifier the article names, or leave the cell empty.
pending.manual two-electrode voltage clamp: Not in any article: replace by the amplifier the article names, or leave the cell empty.
pending.tungsten electrode SSR: The suffix 'SSR' is not in any article. For the studies whose article refers to Dobritsa et al. 2003 the electrode is a glass electrode: pending decision on values given by reference.

Type.definition: Quantity measured, implied by the technique.

Expression system.definition: Host in which the receptor is expressed and recorded: Drosophila olfactory neurons (in vivo), Xenopus oocytes, or HEK cells.

Expression cell type / line.definition: Neuron class (Drosophila) or cell line (HEK) in which the receptor is expressed, as named in the article. Empty for Xenopus oocytes.

ab3A.note: Empty neuron of the ab3 sensillum.

at1.note: Neuron of the at1 (T1) trichoid sensillum.

ab2.note: ab2 sensillum; the article gives no neuron letter.

pending.TREx/HEK293: Spelling of the T-REx HEK293 line to confirm in the article.
pending.Xenopus oocyte: Same as the Expression system: leave the cell empty, as the other oocyte studies do.
pending.wild-type OSN: Replace by the neuron class the article identifies.

Expression driver.definition: Genetic element that drives expression of the receptor: the GAL4 line for Drosophila, the expression vector for Xenopus oocytes and HEK cells. Never a Kozak motif, a primer sequence, a genotype or the vector of a UAS responder.

pending.pUAS: Vector of the UAS responder, not a driver: replace by the GAL4 line of the article.
pending.pSP64DV: Vector name not found in the article.
pending.SP6: RNA polymerase promoter, not a vector.

Co-transfection.definition: Calcium sensor or other transgene co-expressed in the recorded cells. The co-receptor goes in the Co-Receptor block. Empty when there is none.

Odor delivery system.definition: How the stimulus physically reaches the preparation.

airborne paper.note: Odorant on filter paper in a cartridge (Pasteur pipette or syringe), air pulse redirected into a continuous airstream.

airborne headspace.note: Headspace of a vial or flask, sampled and injected into the airstream.

airborne no paper.note: Compound applied directly in the cartridge, without filter paper, heated.

pending.airstream: The airstream is the carrier, not a delivery mode.
pending.gas chromatography: Pipette pulses are not gas chromatography: replace by the delivery mode of the article.
pending.passive diffusion: Capillary tip approached and put in contact with the sensillum: needs its own value.
